instruction: Open Terminal from the left dock (>_ icon). In the Terminal, create/ensure the Desktop/test_files folder exists and write a verification file by running: mkdir -p ~/Desktop/test_files && echo 'Terminal verification OK' > ~/Desktop/test_files/verify.txt

verification.condition: Check if the file ~/Desktop/test_files/verify.txt exists and its content equals the single line "Terminal verification OK"
verification.expected_result: File ~/Desktop/test_files/verify.txt is present and contains exactly: Terminal verification OK
